body:
# Jazz Parks

# Superintendent

![](/media/uploads/2026/10/Jazz-Parks-Headshot-1-scaled.jpg)

Sent [an email](https://web.archive.org/web/20260423024725/https:/www.a2schools.org/superintendent/superintendent-messages-2024-25/january-28-2026-aaps-superintendent-message) to the community regarding arrests made by Immigration and Customs Enforcement at a bus stop. She said what occurred was, “deeply troubling, concerning and undermines the sense of safety that all families deserve.”

- To avoid ICE, Parks said, “As an additional precaution, we have taken down the AAPS bus routes from the district website.” However, ICE said they [did NOT](https://web.archive.org/web/20260211082703/https:/www.fox2detroit.com/news/ice-refutes-claims-agents-targeted-parents-ypsilanti-school-bus-stop) target parents at a bus stop and that they “were not, and will not, do any enforcement on school grounds, or school bus stops.”
- What really happened: “officers were looking to apprehend undocumented immigrants with final orders of removal on Tuesday when they saw two vehicles leave the home of one of the targeted people. Agents conducted a traffic stop, the spokesperson said, and detained three people - two from Honduras and one from Mexico. A fourth person, who is also from Honduras, was detained from the second vehicle.”
- Parks put out a message supporting [student protests](https://web.archive.org/web/20260519101713/https:/www.a2schools.org/superintendent/communications-department/weekly-updates/january-30-2026-aaps-weekly-update).
